figurative_meaning_en: As beautiful as the newborn Kartik
example_sentences_in_english: The child looks as beautiful as newborn Kartik.
Her face resembles the beauty of newborn Kartik.
history: Refers to Kartikeya (Kartik), the Hindu god and son of Shiva and Parvati, often depicted as a handsome newborn in mythological tales.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology prevalent in Bengali culture.
